CONFIRM.TITLE: Confirm moving this number to Bloomwire
CONFIRM.SUBTITLE: Before you continue, please understand what happens when you move this number to Bloomwire.
CONFIRM.APPROVAL: Meta must approve this migration before it completes — you may be asked to confirm it during the Meta window.
CONFIRM.PREVIOUS_PROVIDER: Your previous provider loses messaging access to this number once the migration completes.
CONFIRM.HISTORY: Message history from your previous provider is not transferred to Bloomwire.
CONFIRM.CANCEL: If you reject or cancel the migration at Meta, your existing provider keeps the number and Bloomwire does not take it over.
CONFIRM.ASSET: This does not delete the phone-number asset or WABA at Meta — only the messaging provider changes.
CONFIRM.PREREQ_TITLE: Before you start — your Bloomwire manager confirms these prerequisites

PREREQ.TWO_STEP: Two-step verification (the number’s PIN) must be turned off on this number with your current provider before it can be moved — Meta requires this first.
PREREQ.SOURCE_ELIGIBLE: The number must already be live on the WhatsApp Cloud API (or On-Premises API) with your current provider and in good standing.
PREREQ.VERIFIED_BUSINESS: A verified Meta Business and an approved WhatsApp Business Account (WABA).
PREREQ.PAYMENT: The existing (source) WhatsApp Business Account must have a valid payment method in good standing — Meta requires this on the number being moved.
PREREQ.PARTNER: When applicable, Meta’s partner-to-partner migration obligations — including any Solution Partner requirements and destination credit-line sharing — are arranged by your Bloomwire manager.

BLOOMWIRE.SIGNUP: Runs Meta’s Embedded Signup migration for this number in the window that opens next.
BLOOMWIRE.REGISTER: Registers the number on Bloomwire and sets up message routing once Meta approves the move.

CONFIRM.AVAILABILITY_NOTE: Migration runs as a Bloomwire-assisted setup: your Bloomwire manager confirms eligibility and completes the Meta-side steps with you.
CONFIRM.ACK: I understand these prerequisites — including turning off two-step verification on this number — and want to continue.

ACTION_REQUIRED.STEP_DESC: In Meta Business Settings, grant this WhatsApp Business Account the Manage task to the connected system user, then choose Recheck permission below.

ACTION_REQUIRED.READY_SUBTITLE: Outbound messaging is enabled — this inbox can now send and receive messages.

REASON.PERMISSION_REQUIRED: Outbound messaging isn’t enabled yet. Grant this WhatsApp Business Account the Manage task to the connected system user in Meta Business Settings, then Recheck.
REASON.UNVERIFIABLE: We couldn’t verify the permission with Meta just now — this doesn’t mean it’s missing. Please Recheck again in a moment.
REASON.ACTIVATION_INCOMPLETE: The permission is granted, but we couldn’t finish activating the inbox. Please Recheck again in a moment.

DISCONNECT.CONFIRM: Disconnecting deregisters this number on WhatsApp — it will stop receiving and sending messages until you reconnect it. Your inbox, conversations and settings are kept, and reconnecting from Add Inbox reuses them.
DISCONNECT.DISCONNECTED_SUBTITLE: This number is deregistered on WhatsApp. Reconnect it any time from Settings → Inboxes → Add Inbox — your existing inbox and history are reused.
DISCONNECT.MOBILE_ACTION_TITLE: Disconnect from the WhatsApp Business app
DISCONNECT.MOBILE_ACTION_INSTRUCTIONS: This number is connected through the WhatsApp Business app, so it is disconnected from the phone — not from here. On the device, open: WhatsApp Business App → Settings → Account → Business Platform → Disconnect.
DISCONNECT.MOBILE_ACTION_DETAIL: Bloomwire keeps this inbox until Meta notifies us that this number was disconnected, then updates it automatically. Your local inbox and history stay unchanged until then — you can refresh the status here to check.
DISCONNECT.MOBILE_STILL_CONNECTED: We haven’t detected the disconnect yet. Finish the steps above in the WhatsApp Business app; Bloomwire updates this automatically once Meta notifies us. Refresh again in a moment.
DISCONNECT.MOBILE_REFRESH_FAILED: We couldn’t refresh the status just now. Nothing was changed — please try again in a moment.
DISCONNECT.FAILED_DETAIL: We couldn’t confirm this number was disconnected at Meta, so nothing was changed. Please try again in a moment.

ASYNC.PROCESSING: Setting up your WhatsApp number — this can take a little while. You can keep this page open.
ASYNC.LONGER_THAN_USUAL: This is taking a little longer than usual. We’re still working on it — you don’t need to do anything.
